title: Binary Domain
provenance: Reported by udance4ever (highball-db#345, 2026-10-05), Apple M1, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.8, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r21, the environment in D3DMetal mode (Direct3D 9 runs through DXVK there), with .NET 3.5 SP1, .NET 4.8, SDL controllers, core fonts and the Visual C++ runtimes installed. Reaches the game and plays, but the sound is broken. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Gets in game with high frame rates once its configuration tool and the game run the same way, and the sound is broken. The game stores the graphics card's ID from BinaryDomainConfiguration.exe and refuses to start when the game sees another one. On the default engine in D3DMetal or DXVK mode a Direct3D 9 game sees the Mac's chip with an ID that stays the same from run to run, while Wine's own Direct3D and the Wine 11 engine show a different card (measured on an M4, 2026-10-05). The player added the configuration tool to the environment's programs so both run in the same mode. The CRI audio middleware loads XAudio 2.7, which the Linux fix replaces with Microsoft's own; the 'Microsoft XAudio 2.7 and XACT' dependency does that here, and on Binary Domain it did not stop the stutter (the player still hears and sees it, 0.10.9).

knownIssues.symptom: 'Critical Error! Graphics device is invalid, please run the configuration tool' and the game quits
knownIssues.cause: The configuration tool saved a graphics card ID that differs from the one the game sees, after a change of graphics mode or engine
knownIssues.fix: Run BinaryDomainConfiguration.exe from the game folder in the same environment and mode as the game (adding it to the environment's programs keeps it there), save, then start the game

knownIssues.symptom: Sound and picture stutter together in game
knownIssues.cause: Not diagnosed. Microsoft's XAudio 2.7 (the Linux fix for this game's CRI audio) did not change it here (highball-db#345, 0.10.9). Sound and picture stuttering together points at the CPU side of a 2012 32-bit game under Rosetta rather than at audio
knownIssues.fix: None known yet. DXVK async shader compilation in the environment's Graphics settings removes only the stutter of shaders compiling for the first time

knownIssues.symptom: The picture spans the external monitor and the laptop screen
knownIssues.fix: Set 1920x1080 and Windowed in the game's options

knownIssues.symptom: A controller works in menus but not in play
knownIssues.cause: Steam Input sits between the controller and the game's XInput path (the same on Linux)
knownIssues.fix: Turn Steam Input off for the game in its Steam properties

knownIssues.symptom: A 'Microsoft .NET Framework 3.5 Setup' error box ('You must use Turn Windows features on or off...') behind Steam's 'Setup is loading installation components', at every start
knownIssues.cause: Steam runs the game's first-start step, which installs .NET 3.5 from Steam's redistributables, before each launch, and Microsoft's 3.5 installer refuses to run on the Windows 10 that Wine reports (screenshot in highball-db#345). Installing dotnet35sp1 with winetricks did not silence it for the reporter
knownIssues.fix: harmless: press OK and the game starts

knownIssues.symptom: Controller button hints show as plain black squares
